takes.name: cand-a
takes.text: Then pick a time, and Machina reminds you to read it.
takes.style: Calm, warm and reassuring, like telling a friend a simple fact. A plain declarative sentence: the pitch steps down through 'to read it' and lands low and settled on 'it', the way a sentence ends at a full stop. Not excited, no upward inflection anywhere at the end. Pace: Conversational and easy, about 165 words a minute; short natural pauses. The product name "Machina" is the Latin word, said the classical Latin way: MAH-kee-nah, stress on the FIRST syllable; "ch" is a hard "k"; open vowels, "a" as in "father" (not as in "cat"), a short "ee", and a clear "ah" at the end, not "nuh". Never mah-KEE-nah.

takes.style: Quietly confident and warm, a touch lower in pitch. Stress 'reminds', then let the voice fall away gently on 'to read it.', finished and final, like the end of a thought.
